editorNote: Gold stays under $4,000, bitcoin sits in the high $70,000s through election day, and Duolingo reports tonight. Most items rest on headlines only.

stories.headline: Gold opens below $4,000 for a second straight day, Yahoo Finance reports; Commerzbank calls the decline excessive
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance's Nov. 3 gold report says prices opened below $4,000 for the second straight day, and an Economic Times headline describes a drop on US midterm Election Day. FXStreet's headline attributes to Commerzbank the view that the price decline is excessive.
stories.whyItMatters: Spot gold, a watchlist holding, extends last week's slide below a round-number level; the analyst view is one bank's opinion, not a forecast we endorse.

sourceLinks.title: Gold price today, Tuesday, November 3, 2026 - Yahoo Finance
Gold: Price decline seen as excessive – Commerzbank - FXStreet
Gold price crashes on Election Day, Silver drops - The Economic Times

stories.headline: Alibaba jumps 6% as Apple sets a December launch for Qwen-powered iPhone AI in China, TIKR headline says
stories.summary: A TIKR.com headline published Tuesday says Alibaba rose 6% as Apple set a December launch for Qwen-powered iPhone AI in China. Only the headline was available to us; the article body could not be read.
stories.whyItMatters: The headline moves the timing of the Apple–Alibaba AI tie-up, which this paper previously reported as opening for testing on Nov. 4, to December; the details are unverified.

sourceLinks.title: Alibaba Soars 6% as Apple Sets December Launch for Qwen-Powered iPhone AI in China - TIKR.com

stories.headline: Alphabet's euro bond sale draws investor questions, Yahoo Finance says; IBD notes Wall Street has lowered its Google Search revenue bar
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance runs a piece on how investors may respond to an Alphabet euro bond sale. Investor's Business Daily's headline says Wall Street has lowered the revenue bar for Google Search. Both bodies were unavailable to us; this relies on the headlines.
stories.whyItMatters: Alphabet is tapping the euro bond market while analyst search-revenue expectations reset after its Q3 report.

sourceLinks.title: How Investors May Respond To Alphabet Stock Euro Bond Sale - Yahoo Finance

stories.headline: Bitcoin trades near $77,500 as midterm voting begins, Bitcoin Magazine says; CoinDesk says it is breaking a pre-2014 election pattern
stories.summary: Bitcoin Magazine's headline puts bitcoin near $77,500 as US midterm voting begins. CoinDesk's Crypto Daily headline says bitcoin is breaking a midterm election pattern going back to 2014. Only headlines were available.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin remains below the roughly $81,000 level it touched on Oct. 28, before the Binance hack.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $77,500 As Midterm Voting Begins - Bitcoin Magazine

stories.headline: Duolingo reports third-quarter results after the market close today
stories.summary: Duolingo said it would announce Q3 2026 results after the US market close on Tuesday, Nov. 3, with a 5:00 p.m. ET webcast. Per a Zacks-sourced summary, management guided Q3 revenue to about $302 million, or roughly 11.1% growth, below the $305.9 million consensus.
stories.whyItMatters: A watchlist holding reports tonight; results were not yet available when this edition was assembled.

stories.headline: Tether owns $11.5 billion worth of bitcoin, Yahoo Finance headline says
stories.summary: A Yahoo Finance headline says Tether owns $11.5 billion worth of bitcoin. Only the headline was available to us, so the basis of the figure is not verified.
stories.whyItMatters: It sizes one stablecoin issuer's bitcoin holdings, though the figure is unverified here.
